title: Fullmetal Alchemist
description: Edward Elric, a young, brilliant alchemist, has lost much in his twelve-year life: when he and his brother Alphonse try to resurrect their dead mother through the forbidden act of human transmutation, Edward loses his brother as well as two of his limbs. With his supreme alchemy skills, Edward binds Alphonse’s soul to a large suit of armor.A year later, Edward, now promoted to the fullmetal alchemist of the state, embarks on a journey with his younger brother to obtain the Philosopher’s Stone. The fabled mythical object is rumored to be capable of amplifying an alchemist’s abilities by leaps and bounds, thus allowing them to override the fundamental law of alchemy: to gain something, an alchemist must sacrifice something of equal value. Edward hopes to draw into the military’s resources to find the fabled stone and restore his and Alphonse’s bodies to normal. However, the Elric brothers soon discover that there is more to the legendary stone than meets the eye, as they are led to the epicenter of a far darker battle than they could have ever imagined.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: When Edward and Alphonse meet a so-called religious leader who can invoke miracles, they believe he's carrying the philosopher's stone.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Edward and Alphonse struggle over whether they should reveal the truth behind Cornello's miracles -- and possibly ruin the townspeople's lives.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: A young Ed and Al are determined to bring back their dead mother, who was their pillar of strength during dreary times of war.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: While on their way to seek out an important man from their childhood, Ed and Al come across a town haunted by a ghostly woman.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Ed and Al hop aboard a train to Central City and quickly find themselves defending the passengers -- including Gen. Hakuro -- from terrorists.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Once in Central City, Ed and Al move into the vast mansion of sewing-life alchemist Shou Tucker and begin to prepare for the Alchemy Exam.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Now an official State Alchemist, Ed takes a closer look at Tucker's chimera experiments and begins to realize there's something very wrong going on.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: A disenchanted Ed resigns from his position as State Alchemist, and when Winry arrives in town, she may be the serial killer's next victim.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Ed and Al go on assignment to inspect a small mining colony and discover its inhabitants are being heavily taxed by a tyrant and his Alchemist.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: While trying to avoid their meeting with Mustang, Ed and Al end up in a small town and become embroiled in a manhunt for a female Robin Hood.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Ed and Al head to Xenotime in hopes of finding the Philosopher's Stone, but they find only two boys creating a strange red water.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Ed and Al uncover a conspiracy involving the Tringham Brothers' father, his involvement with the red water and the disease that's stricken Xenotime.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Ed reports back to Mustang in East City, where discussion of Doctor Marcoh and the Philosopher's Stone leads to a duel between Ed and the colonel.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: While the shape-shifting Envy disguises himself as Cornello, Ed and Al find Marcoh and learn about the Stone's involvement in the Ishbal Rebellion.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: As the Strong Arm Alchemist defends them from the surrounding chaos, Marcoh reveals to the Elrics the vast atrocities of the Ishbal Massacre.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: As Marcoh faces a deadly encounter with Lust, Armstrong and the Elrics flee to Resembool. Ed is sent into a rage when they lose Al in the process.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: While resting and receiving repairs back in Resembool, Ed visits his mother's grave and Al reveals his concerns about his fading memories.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: Ed and Al are forced to go in search of another source for Marcoh's book after Lust, Gluttony and Scar burn the First Branch Library to the ground.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: Ed and Al are horrified when they learn what the key ingredient in making a Philosopher's Stone is, but they forge ahead to explore an abandoned lab.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: Several malfunctions in their armor impede Ed and Al as they face off against some tortured souls bound to empty suits.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: Barry sets off a series of explosions that inadvertently free Greed and the other prisoners. Tucker returns from the dead in a surprising new form.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: As Envy, in the form of Basque Grand, gathers the human ingredients to form the Stone, Maes Hughes sets out to rescue the Elrics from Laboratory 5.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: Edward upsets Winry with his refusal to talk, and Alphonse decides to confront Edward with his questions about artificial souls.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: Alphonse runs off and comes face to face with Scar, who's been hiding out among the mercenary-plagued refugees of Ishbal.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 25
episodes_data.description: When Ed and Al take Winry on a quest to tail Scar and learn more about the Stone, they discover a connection between Lab 5 and the war in Ishbal.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 26
episodes_data.description: As Ed, Al and Winry arrive in Rush Valley to retrieve automail, Mustang figures that a high-ranking officer must be responsible for Hughes' death.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 27
episodes_data.description: Edward and Alphonse fear for their lives when they come face to face with Izumi Curtis, their former teacher, who brings them back to Dublith.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 28
episodes_data.description: In order to teach them a life lesson and give them time to reflect, Izumi leaves Ed and Al on Yock Island -- the place where she first found them.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 29
episodes_data.description: Edward and Alphonse discover that the young boy on Yock Island is, all at once, an alchemist, a homunculus and able to transmute his own body.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 30
episodes_data.description: As the military captures the mysterious Yock Island boy and imprisons him in South Headquarters, Yoki spots Scar among a group of Ishbalans.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 31
episodes_data.description: Envy disguises herself as Bradley and plucks the homunculus child from Izumi. Meanwhile, the boy remembers his past after he eats Stone fragments.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 32
episodes_data.description: Izumi drops in on Ed and Al's fight with Wrath, a new homunculus who seeks the rest of Edward's body in order to make himself human.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 33
episodes_data.description: When Martel takes over Al's armor and brings him to Greed's headquarters, it's up to Izumi and Edward to come to the rescue

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 34
episodes_data.description: With Ed, Izumi and Sig in his custody, Lt. Col. Archer reinstates Shou Tucker as State Alchemist and orders his men to hunt down Greed.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 35
episodes_data.description: As Edward and Alphonse head out to the Ishbal camp with Winry, Lust is sitting down at a restaurant when a man from her past enters the room.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 36
episodes_data.description: Ed and Alphonse hope to learn more about the Philosopher's Stone when they lend a hand to a group of Ishbalan refugees being shipped further south.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 37
episodes_data.description: While he investigates Mustang, Lt. Havoc orders his man Falman to find him a girlfriend. Later, Mustang must investigate the haunted Warehouse 13.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 38
episodes_data.description: After an argument splits up Ed, Al and Winry, Al bumps into a familiar face, and Winry decides to investigate Hughes' murder with Sheska.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 39
episodes_data.description: Kimblee is named State Alchemist and heads out with the troops to Liore, where Scar is gouging out the earth with a large stone.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 40
episodes_data.description: After Lust and Gluttony drop in on Edward's confrontation with Scar in Liore, the seventh and final homunculus is finally revealed.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 41
episodes_data.description: With the help of Rose, the Holy Mother, Scar instructs the inhabitants of Liore not to provoke violence as they lure the military into town.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 42
episodes_data.description: With Ed busy aiding the people of Liore, Scar is the only one who can help Alphonse when his armor begins transforming into an explosive compound.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 43
episodes_data.description: While the Elric Brothers flee Liore, Winry meets a complete stranger in Resembool who is later introduced to her as Ed and Al's father.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 44
episodes_data.description: As the Elrics' father, Hohenhelm of Light, sets out to confront the leader of the Homunculi, Lyra and Rose find a secret stairway in an old church.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 45
episodes_data.description: A complex and entangled history reveals itself as Van Hohenheim of Light battles Dante, the leader of the Homunculi.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 46
episodes_data.description: The brothers are in danger when they become separated. Ed returns to Dante's mansion to look for clues. Al meets with the deranged Shou Tucker.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 47
episodes_data.description: Wrath believes that Sloth is his real mother. Sloth battles Shou Tucker. Ed realizes that Al has been tricked by Tucker.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 48
episodes_data.description: Armstrong declares an uprising against the Führer on the northern border while Ed, joined by Izumi, fights the remaining Homunculi in Central.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 49
episodes_data.description: King Bradley comes home to give his son a birthday gift. Edward meets with Russell in an abandoned church. Maria and Denny arrive to support Izumi.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 50
episodes_data.description: Edward Elric arrives in World War I after being pulled through the Gate. Roy Mustang confronts his enemy, Homunculus Pride.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist Season 1 Episode 51
episodes_data.description: Edward Elric realizes he must make the ultimate sacrifice if he wants to retrieve his brother from the Gate. Hawkeye breaks free from her captors.
